what: Our real gate case (LNCT Excellence main gate, Bhopal; 8.6 min analysed) worked with every reasoning step on Meta open-weights models, 4 Nov 2026 (IST), on a frozen copy of the repo and a copy of out/gate. No Meta API key was set for the review, agent or letter steps, and every host except api.fireworks.ai was sent to a dead proxy for the whole run, so no Meta API call could succeed.

steps.step: person review (is each tracked near-miss pedestrian a person?)
steps.how: analyze.py --budget 0 with REVIEW_MODEL_URL; same prompt and crops as Muse Spark; reasoning_effort low
steps.request_ids: not kept by review.py (it saves the reply text beside each crop); per-crop tokens in review.json

steps.step: case agent (chooses tools, asks a person for the tape, files the letter)
steps.where: api.fireworks.ai (Fireworks serverless), tool calling, tool_choice required
steps.person: R1 answered: 15 m (the taped check distance)

steps.how: pack.ask_plan through the agent's submit_letter, LETTER_MODEL_URL, json_schema

steps.where: Fireworks on-demand deployment cw-judge-open-gate, live merge
steps.how: pack.ask_plan's JUDGE_MODEL_URL call, the only judge (no Meta key); then 3 re-reads through the same call (judge_case.py)
steps.verdicts: no unsupported claim, in product and in all 3 re-reads

deployment.name: accounts/<fireworks-account>/deployments/cw-judge-open-gate
log_ist: submit_letter: Video 15.0 m, tape 15 m, 0% off: proven. Letter written by Muse Spark Open (open weights, on Fireworks); waiting for the head of the school.
judge reads done Wed Nov  4 01:21:42 IST 2026
deployment.checked_again: Wed 04 Nov 2026 01:22:28 IST: deployments listed: []; get cw-judge-open-gate: state DELETED
deployment.safety: trap on EXIT deletes it; expire_time 1 h as a backstop
deployment.price: $8.00 per GPU-hour, billed per second (fireworks.ai/pricing, read 2 Nov 2026)

not_open_weights.SAM 3.1: no open-weights equivalent used: every tracking reply (200 video requests, crowd-mode images, 6 number-plate requests) re-read from the hosted run's cache; $0 new
not_open_weights.Muse Wonder: no open-weights equivalent: the 5 cached listening replies reused (same audio bytes); no new call
not_open_weights.Muse Image: no open-weights equivalent: not called, so this run has no new picture of the fix

gaps: analyze.py stops without MODEL_API_KEY even when it calls no Meta model (every SAM reply cached, review on REVIEW_MODEL_URL). For the tracking steps it got a placeholder that is not a key, behind the network guard; the letter step ran with no MODEL_API_KEY at all, so Muse Spark could not judge.
Labels: agent.py's review tool says "Muse Spark reviewed 32 pedestrians" and analyze.py prints "Spark verdicts" / "[Spark: ...]" even when Muse Spark Open reviewed; wording only.
review.py keeps no response id, and pack.py keeps none for the judge; the judge's 3 re-reads in judge.json carry them.
